It snaps onto the back of your phone and just charges. 🔋

This is Anker's MagGo power bank. It has a 10,000mAh battery, Qi2 certified 15W wireless charging, and a smart display on the front.

The foldable stand lets you watch a video while it tops up, and a USB-C cable is included.

Tip: the snap-on wireless charging is for iPhone 13 through 16, so check your model first.
